creativeThesis: A choice that seems to select strength reveals a circular relationship between possible outcomes.
viewerExperience: Choose → understand one favorable reply → reconsider → follow two weighted proofs → see the circle → understand why advantage is conditional and never certain.
emotionalTarget: Playful curiosity followed by a satisfying reconstruction, without gambling pressure or fake defeat.
visualThesis: Preserve the identities of four dice while their faces become weighted possibilities; each new opponent changes which outcomes win, and the final spatial circle makes that dependence visible.

decisions.treatment: Propose original spatial dice illustration on one tactile play surface, with graphic face inventories and weighted branch overlays integrated into the same object journey. Treat apparent rolls as illustrative transitions or explicitly possible outcomes, never measured trials. No generated bitmaps or new production models at development. V2 visual proof uses the unchanged verified sample space and leaves the full18+6/12+12calculations visible without reciting them. Name/number identities persist.
decisions.rationale: Choice feels concrete; face distributions and change of opponent should be inspectable rather than narrated over spectacle. Mixing spatial objects with clear graphic proof can improve both involvement and truth.
alternativesConsidered: Immersive tactile playing surface: the same dice reveal their faces and split into weighted possibilities, then re-form into a circular counter-choice.
Direct overhead physical demonstration with occasional transparent explanatory overlays.
Flat outcome-first illustrated theatre, using six face tiles and weighted groups without rolling cubes.
Inherited fixed dark central panel with four dice rows, arrows and successive probability headings.

decisions.treatment: A softly lit mineral-grey playing surface with four saturated but distinguishable die colors: yellow, blue, green and orange, matching the canonical source labels. Numbers and written die names carry identity as well as color. Crisp material edges, soft depth shadows and a close viewpoint serve number readability. No permanent top heading, central card or generic HUD.
decisions.rationale: The surface anchors a puzzle the viewer could handle; the four colors are object identifiers, not domain palette or novelty rotation. Explore lighter versus darker surface contrast internally after authorization if phone-scale numbers require it.

decisions.treatment: Current Kokoro af_heart, conversational invitation and lightly surprised reconsideration, followed by unhurried explanations. No new voice audition or TTS. Four fours, zero, twenty-four and thirty-six must be clear in full sentences; speech rhythm should distinguish the two winning branches.
decisions.rationale: Brand continuity is independent of visual style. Numerically dense passages must sound like understandable observations, not an accelerated math recital. Actual delivery/listening acceptance remains untested.

decisions.treatment: Designed burned-in speech-first phrases, proposed licensed Manrope with sentence case, strong scene contrast and short natural groups. Position follows live die/branch focus rather than an inherited lower slot; avoid competing duplication of every spoken number in a second fact stack. Keep all wording and meaningful punctuation.
decisions.rationale: Names/numbers on dice explain the proof while captions carry speech. A compact readable caption field must not cover face multiplicities or introduce a false win claim. Exact cues, font size and safe bounds remain unauthorized production work.

decisions.treatment: Propose restrained original dry object-placement/turn cues and a brief subtle pause before the circle closes. Compare voice-only with sparse cues later; no selected music bed. Any dice sound is illustrative, not a field recording or evidence of random physical outcomes.
decisions.rationale: Sound can mark a new opponent and let the final relationship settle. Continuous casino/game-show excitement or repeated victory chimes would imply certainty and distract from number meaning. No audio generated.

decisions.treatment: 128 spoken words;46.5–53seconds estimated speech at145–165words/min, plus6–12seconds provisional mental-choice/proof recognition yields52.5–65seconds. Estimate only; no fixed60second target or measured narration.
decisions.rationale: Reducing recited arithmetic creates space to look at the correct weighted possibilities. Preserve enough actual recognition time; do not turn shorter narration into a faster unexplained demonstration.

decisions.treatment: Pick a die. Higher number wins. Whatever you choose, I can pick one with better odds. Four persistent tactile dice and compact winning rule present immediately; model assumptions follow. Narration is proposed, not yet approved.
decisions.rationale: Shorten the invitation and state the rule before the counter-choice challenge. This retains the approved participation/treatment rather than a new template or certain-win promise.

decisions.treatment: Conceptual vertical short with large numbers, persistent die names and thoughtfully placed phrase captions. Plan readable pairwise focus rather than fitting all432 outcomes or four dense grids on a phone. Native exclusions, crop geometry, actual profiles, device evidence, covers and release copy are unprepared.
decisions.rationale: A viewer should follow one matchup at a time. Current conceptual work does not prove phone/device safety; exact media/profile and device review belong to later authorized production/presentation.

portfolioReview.selectionRationale: Four latest available approved/locked masters by actual decision-entry time: DevilsHole, FLIP, Vermeer and Craft. No performance/publication/domain filter.
portfolioReview.proposedFeedImpression: A tactile, mentally participatory puzzle with inspectable numbers and a geometric conceptual payoff. Familiar clarity/voice, no inherited documentary or science-slide layout.
portfolioReview.toolingBiasCheck: Explored physical demonstration, flat illustrated theatre and spatial/graphic integration before rejecting the existing fixed-panel default. Selected treatment follows participation plus proof, not a handy dice engine or available assets.

ownerReview.rationale: The actual owner instruction in production-v1/production-authority.json explicitly approves the exact final creative target and authorizes candidate production. The scoped creative hold is resolved; no exceptional new gate or master/publication approval is inferred.

risks: Four identities and mixed-probability branches can overwhelm; later comprehension review must test retelling without a memorized table.
Every visible face/rotation must preserve the exact multiset; no guessed opposite-face convention, changing labels or apparent throw declared random.
Weighted branches are18+6 and12+12winning indexed combinations; neither value types nor illustrated rolls establish empirical frequency.
No physical fairness, subjective narration listening, audiovisual quality, rendered QA, phone/device safety or audience effect established at this stage.
Source figure copying, assets, audio, cube geometry, exact caption cues, ProductionPlan and renders require later authorization and provenance.
